_: ONE table for every line a file is read by as `<token> <value>`: the value is what follows the token ON THE SAME LINE, and a token with nothing after it on its line reads as no value -- never the line below it, on either line ending. Each row's text is its lines joined by LF, or by CRLF where `crlf` is true, with a final line ending. `reader` names the rule: stampValue (a design file's `**Outcome:**` or `**Closed:**` value, `stamp` the key in consts.json stamps; Get-P20StampValue and design._stamp), docs (design.docsRegex, group 1), thread (studio.threadRegex, group 1) -- asserted by tkTestToolkit -Design and Tests/test_design.py; stampDay (the day after a footer stamp; Get-P20StampDayRegex, re_closed_stamp_date and standup._stamp_day), billable (Test-P20CardBillable, card_billable; expected is whether the card is billable), adoLink (Get-P20CardAdoUrl, card_ado_url), prUrl (Get-P20CardPrUrl, the card model's pr_url), sprint (Get-P20CardSprintLabel, the card model's sprint; '--' for none) and workThread (rituals.workThreadRegex, group 1) -- asserted by tkTestToolkit -PromptStatus and Tests/test_parsers.py. expected '' is no value. docs/hub/cards.md, "3. The footer -- one fact per line"; docs/hub/design.md, "The file".
